"""Exact reviewed-source CARLA entrypoint for NRS 484B.213(2)(c)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_capture import capture
from native_scene import ASSIGNMENT, validate
from source_bind import bind


def run(client, attempt, *, carla_module=None):
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if config.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT:
        raise ValueError("selected assignment mismatch")
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    packet_path = attempt / config["reviewed_packet"]
    source_root = attempt / config["reviewed_source_root"]
    packet = validate(json.loads(packet_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), case_id)
    bound = bind(packet, source_root)
    if not bound:
        raise ValueError("no original source bindings")
    return capture(client, packet, case_id, source_root, attempt,
                   carla_module=carla_module)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--host")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"entrypoint": "runner.py", "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT,
                          "reviewed_original_sources_required": True}, sort_keys=True))
        return
    if not args.host or args.port is None or args.output_dir is None:
        parser.error("--host, --port and --output-dir required")
    import carla
    client = carla.Client(args.host, args.port)
    client.set_timeout(30)
    print(json.dumps(run(client, args.output_dir, carla_module=carla), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Reviewed original bridge-approach CARLA construction and route controller."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
CAMERA_SIZES = ((1920, 1080), (1280, 720), (1280, 720), (1280, 720))
ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C31940__NRS-484B-213-2c__motor_vehicle_driver"
CASE_VARIANTS = {"obstructed_beyond_100ft", "obstructed_at_100ft",
                 "obstructed_within_100ft", "clear_within_100ft",
                 "right_side_within_100ft", "one_way_exception"}


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def vector(values, length, label):
    require(isinstance(values, list) and len(values) == length and
            all(type(v) in (float, int) and math.isfinite(v) for v in values),
            "reviewed " + label + " coordinates required")
    return values


def validate(packet, case_id):
    variant = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    require(case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") and variant in CASE_VARIANTS and
            packet.get("case_id") == case_id, "exact bridge case mismatch")
    require(packet.get("law_id") == "NRS-484B-213-2c" and
            packet.get("cell_id") == "C31940" and
            packet.get("actor") == "motor_vehicle_driver", "scope mismatch")
    require(packet.get("reviewed") is True and packet.get("reviewer") and
            packet.get("review_source_sha256"), "separate original bridge review required")
    require(packet.get("map_opendrive_sha256") and packet.get("fps") == 20 and
            type(packet.get("duration_s")) is int and packet["duration_s"] >= 20,
            "reviewed OpenDRIVE and 20 Hz duration required")
    road = packet.get("road", {})
    require(road.get("public_highway") is True and road.get("structure_type") == "bridge" and
            road.get("bridge_source_sha256") and road.get("centerline_source_sha256") and
            type(road.get("bridge_entrance_station_m")) in (int, float),
            "reviewed bridge, entrance and highway authority required")
    one_way = road.get("one_way_highway")
    require(one_way in (True, False), "reviewed one-way status required")
    require(one_way == (variant == "one_way_exception"), "case highway direction mismatch")
    lanes = road.get("lanes")
    require(isinstance(lanes, list) and len(lanes) >= 2 and
            all(item.get("lane_id") and item.get("direction") in (1, -1) for item in lanes),
            "reviewed lane directions required")
    directions = {item["direction"] for item in lanes}
    require(directions == ({1} if one_way else {1, -1}),
            "one-way exception or opposing lane direction mismatch")
    axis = vector(road.get("forward_unit_xy"), 2, "forward route axis")
    require(abs(math.hypot(*axis)-1) <= .01, "reviewed forward axis not unit length")
    vector(road.get("centerline_origin_xy"), 2, "centerline origin")
    actors = packet.get("actors")
    require(isinstance(actors, dict) and set(actors) == {"ego"},
            "one original ego vehicle required")
    ego = actors["ego"]
    require(str(ego.get("blueprint", "")).startswith("vehicle.") and
            ego.get("direction") == 1 and ego.get("source_sha256"),
            "reviewed ego vehicle and direction required")
    vector(ego.get("pose"), 6, "ego pose")
    route = ego.get("route")
    require(isinstance(route, list) and len(route) >= 2, "reviewed ego route required")
    for point in route:
        vector(point, 3, "ego route point")
    progress = (route[-1][0]-route[0][0])*axis[0] + (route[-1][1]-route[0][1])*axis[1]
    require(progress > 5, "ego route not approaching bridge")
    heading = math.radians(ego["pose"][4])
    require((route[-1][0]-route[0][0])*math.cos(heading) +
            (route[-1][1]-route[0][1])*math.sin(heading) > 5,
            "ego heading contradicts bridge approach")
    require(type(ego.get("target_speed_mps")) in (int, float) and
            0 < ego["target_speed_mps"] < 50, "reviewed ego speed required")
    start_station = (ego["pose"][0]-road["centerline_origin_xy"][0])*axis[0] + (ego["pose"][1]-road["centerline_origin_xy"][1])*axis[1]
    gap_m = road["bridge_entrance_station_m"]-start_station
    requested = {"obstructed_beyond_100ft": 30.7848,
                 "obstructed_at_100ft": 30.48}.get(variant, 30.1752)
    require(abs(gap_m-requested) <= 2.0, "reviewed spawn is outside selected 100-foot probe band")
    if variant != "clear_within_100ft":
        blocker = packet.get("opaque_blocker")
        require(isinstance(blocker, dict) and blocker.get("blueprint") and
                blocker.get("source_sha256") and blocker.get("ray_intersection_plan"),
                "physical opaque view blocker required")
        vector(blocker.get("pose"), 6, "opaque blocker pose")
    cameras = packet.get("cameras")
    require(isinstance(cameras, dict) and set(cameras) == set(CAMERAS),
            "four reviewed camera poses required")
    for name, size in zip(CAMERAS, CAMERA_SIZES):
        camera = cameras[name]
        vector(camera.get("pose"), 6, name + " camera pose")
        require((camera.get("width"), camera.get("height")) == size and
                type(camera.get("fov_deg")) in (float, int) and
                1 <= camera["fov_deg"] <= 170, "pinned four-view profile required")
    return packet


def transform(carla, values):
    x, y, z, pitch, yaw, roll = vector(values, 6, "Native pose")
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                           carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=roll))


class BridgeScene:
    """Owns all new actors/sensors; the operator provides an exclusive client."""

    def __init__(self, client, packet, case_id, source_root, *, carla_module=None,
                 snapshot_fn=None, restore_fn=None, bind_fn=None):
        self.client = client
        self.packet = validate(packet, case_id)
        self.case_id = case_id
        self.carla = carla_module
        self.source_root = source_root
        self.bind_fn = bind_fn
        self.snapshot_fn = snapshot_fn
        self.restore_fn = restore_fn
        self.saved = None
        self.world = None
        self.actors = {}
        self.sensors = {}
        self.closed = False
        self.release = None
        self.route_indices = {role: 0 for role in self.packet["actors"]}
        self.last_world_frame = None

    def begin(self):
        if self.bind_fn is None:
            from source_bind import bind
            self.bind_fn = bind
        self.bound_sources = self.bind_fn(self.packet, self.source_root)
        if self.carla is None:
            import carla
            self.carla = carla
        if self.snapshot_fn is None or self.restore_fn is None:
            from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore
            self.snapshot_fn, self.restore_fn = snapshot, restore
        self.saved = self.snapshot_fn(self.client)
        try:
            self.world = self.client.get_world()
            actual = hashlib.sha256(self.world.get_map().to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest()
            require(actual == self.packet["map_opendrive_sha256"],
                    "live OpenDRIVE differs from reviewed original source")
            settings = self.world.get_settings()
            settings.synchronous_mode = True
            settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
            self.world.apply_settings(settings)
            library = self.world.get_blueprint_library()
            for role, item in self.packet["actors"].items():
                actor = self.world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(item["blueprint"]),
                                                   transform(self.carla, item["pose"]))
                require(actor is not None, "reviewed vehicle spawn failed: " + role)
                self.actors[role] = actor
            if self.case_id.split("__")[-1] != "clear_within_100ft":
                blocker = self.packet["opaque_blocker"]
                actor = self.world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(blocker["blueprint"]),
                                                   transform(self.carla, blocker["pose"]))
                require(actor is not None, "opaque blocker spawn failed")
                self.actors["opaque_blocker"] = actor
            for name in CAMERAS:
                item = self.packet["cameras"][name]
                blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                for key, value in (("image_size_x", item["width"]),
                                   ("image_size_y", item["height"]),
                                   ("fov", item["fov_deg"]), ("sensor_tick", .05)):
                    blueprint.set_attribute(key, str(value))
                sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform(self.carla, item["pose"]))
                require(sensor is not None, "reviewed camera spawn failed: " + name)
                self.sensors[name] = sensor
            return {"case_id": self.case_id, "map_opendrive_sha256": actual,
                    "actor_roles": sorted(self.actors), "cameras": list(CAMERAS),
                    "physical_completion_claimed": False}
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def _apply_route(self, role, episode_frame):
        actor = self.actors[role]
        spec = self.packet["actors"][role]
        route = spec["route"]
        location = actor.get_location()
        index = self.route_indices[role]
        while index < len(route) - 1 and math.hypot(route[index][0]-location.x,
                                                     route[index][1]-location.y) < 2:
            index += 1
        self.route_indices[role] = index
        target = route[index]
        distance = math.hypot(target[0]-location.x, target[1]-location.y)
        if index == len(route)-1 and distance < 2:
            control = self.carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1, steer=0)
            actor.apply_control(control)
            return {"role": role, "route_index": index, "target_speed_mps": 0,
                    "controller_stopped": True}
        transform = actor.get_transform()
        yaw = math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)
        heading = math.atan2(target[1]-location.y, target[0]-location.x)
        error = math.atan2(math.sin(heading-yaw), math.cos(heading-yaw))
        velocity = actor.get_velocity()
        speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)
        requested = spec["target_speed_mps"]
        response = spec.get("response_policy")
        if response and episode_frame >= response["start_frame"]:
            requested = response["target_speed_mps"]
        throttle = max(0.0, min(0.65, 0.20*(requested-speed)))
        brake = max(0.0, min(0.7, 0.25*(speed-requested)))
        steer = max(-0.65, min(0.65, 1.0*error))
        actor.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake,
                                                       steer=steer))
        return {"role": role, "route_index": index, "target_speed_mps": requested,
                "observed_speed_mps": speed, "requested_steer": steer,
                "controller_stopped": False}

    def tick(self, episode_frame):
        require(self.world is not None and not self.closed, "Native scene not active")
        commands = [self._apply_route(role, episode_frame) for role in self.packet["actors"]]
        world_frame = self.world.tick()
        require(type(world_frame) is int and
                (self.last_world_frame is None or world_frame == self.last_world_frame+1),
                "original CARLA world frame discontinuity")
        self.last_world_frame = world_frame
        return {"world_frame": world_frame, "commands": commands}

    def close(self):
        if self.closed:
            return self.release
        errors = []
        for sensor in reversed(list(self.sensors.values())):
            for operation in (sensor.stop, sensor.destroy):
                try:
                    operation()
                except Exception as exc:
                    errors.append(str(exc))
        for actor in reversed(list(self.actors.values())):
            try:
                actor.destroy()
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
        restored = None
        if self.saved is not None:
            try:
                restored = self.restore_fn(self.client, self.saved)
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
        self.release = {"actors_released": not errors, "sensors_released": not errors,
                        "world_restored": bool(restored and restored.get("restored")),
                        "restoration": restored, "errors": errors}
        self.closed = True
        require((self.release["world_restored"] or self.saved is None) and not errors,
                "release or restoration readback failed: " + "; ".join(errors))
        return self.release

"""One synchronized original Native episode for a reviewed passing construction.

The live caller owns exclusive CARLA access. This module never launches a server.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from native_scene import CAMERAS, BridgeScene


def _write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _hash(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _state(actor, axis, origin):
    transform = actor.get_transform()
    bounds = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
    points = [(v.x-origin[0], v.y-origin[1]) for v in bounds]
    stations = [x*axis[0]+y*axis[1] for x, y in points]
    laterals = [-x*axis[1]+y*axis[0] for x, y in points]
    center = actor.get_location()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    return {"actor_id": actor.id, "vehicle": True,
            "station_m": (center.x-origin[0])*axis[0]+(center.y-origin[1])*axis[1],
            "front_station_m": max(stations), "rear_station_m": min(stations),
            "centerline_signed_body_edge_m": max(laterals),
            "speed_mps": math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2),
            "lateral_m": -(center.x-origin[0])*axis[1]+(center.y-origin[1])*axis[0],
            "body_vertices_xy_m": [[v.x, v.y] for v in bounds]}


def _ray(scene, ego, axis, distance_m=230.0):
    carla = scene.carla
    loc = ego.get_location()
    start = carla.Location(x=loc.x, y=loc.y, z=loc.z+1.4)
    # A forward left-side ray is an observer proxy, not a driver-eye claim.
    end = carla.Location(x=start.x+axis[0]*distance_m-axis[1]*2,
                         y=start.y+axis[1]*distance_m+axis[0]*2, z=start.z)
    hits = list(scene.world.cast_ray(start, end))
    if hits:
        hit = hits[0]
        point = hit.location
        length = math.sqrt((point.x-start.x)**2+(point.y-start.y)**2+(point.z-start.z)**2)
        kind = "vehicle" if str(getattr(hit, "label", "")).lower().endswith("vehicles") else "opaque_obstacle"
        return {"clear_distance_m": length, "censored": False, "hit_kind": kind,
                "hit_actor_id": getattr(hit, "actor_id", None),
                "hit_label": str(getattr(hit, "label", ""))}
    return {"clear_distance_m": distance_m, "censored": True, "hit_kind": "range_limit"}


def _encoder(path, width, height):
    return subprocess.Popen(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-f", "rawvideo",
                             "-pix_fmt", "bgra", "-s", f"{width}x{height}",
                             "-r", "20", "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "libx264rgb",
                             "-preset", "ultrafast", "-qp", "0", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24",
                             "-y", str(path)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE)


def capture(client, packet, case_id, source_root, output, *, carla_module=None,
            scene_factory=BridgeScene, graph_factory=None):
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, write_result, seal_capture
    output = Path(output)
    if not output.is_dir() or any((output / name).exists() for name in
                                 ("trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "capture-seal.json", "result.json")):
        raise ValueError("fresh materialized Native attempt required")
    scene = scene_factory(client, packet, case_id, source_root, carla_module=carla_module)
    encoders = {}
    cameras = {}
    condition = threading.Condition()
    pending = {}
    graph = None
    original_count = 0
    release = None
    try:
        setup = scene.begin()
        retained = output / "reviewed-sources"
        retained.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
        for role, ref in scene.bound_sources.items():
            shutil.copyfile(ref["path"], retained / (role + ".source"))
            if _hash(retained / (role + ".source")) != ref["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("reviewed source changed during retention")
        axis = packet["road"]["forward_unit_xy"]
        origin = packet["road"]["centerline_origin_xy"]
        if graph_factory is None:
            from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
            graph_factory = PipelineCapture
        graph = graph_factory(client, scene.actors["ego"], output, case_id)
        for name in CAMERAS:
            item = packet["cameras"][name]
            encoders[name] = _encoder(output / f"{name}.mkv", item["width"], item["height"])
            def callback(image, view=name):
                with condition:
                    if view in pending.setdefault(image.frame, {}):
                        raise ValueError("duplicate original camera callback")
                    pending[image.frame][view] = image
                    condition.notify_all()
            scene.sensors[name].listen(callback)
        _write(output / "road-context.json", packet["road"])
        _write(output / "acquisition-provenance.json", {"provenance_kind": "native",
                "diagnostic_fixture": False, "case_id": case_id,
                "review_source_sha256": packet["review_source_sha256"],
                "source_bindings": scene.bound_sources})
        with FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
             (output / "trace.jsonl").open("x") as trace, \
             (output / "bridge-history.jsonl").open("x") as history:
            last_time = None
            for index in range(packet["duration_s"]*20):
                step = scene.tick(index)
                world_frame = step["world_frame"]
                snapshot = scene.world.get_snapshot()
                timestamp = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                if last_time is not None and abs(timestamp-last_time-.05) > .002:
                    raise ValueError("Native 20 Hz timestamp discontinuity")
                last_time = timestamp
                with condition:
                    ready = condition.wait_for(lambda: set(pending.get(world_frame, {})) == set(CAMERAS), timeout=15)
                    if not ready:
                        raise ValueError("missing synchronized original camera callback")
                    images = pending.pop(world_frame)
                for name in CAMERAS:
                    image = images[name]
                    spec = packet["cameras"][name]
                    if (image.width, image.height) != (spec["width"], spec["height"]):
                        raise ValueError("original camera dimensions differ")
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(bytes(image.raw_data))
                frame_map.append(world_frame, timestamp, camera_frames={name: world_frame for name in CAMERAS})
                participants = {role: dict(_state(scene.actors[role], axis, origin),
                                           direction=packet["actors"][role]["direction"])
                                for role in packet["actors"]}
                ray = _ray(scene, scene.actors["ego"], axis)
                record = {"original_frame": index, "frame": world_frame,
                          "carla_frame": world_frame,
                          "time_s": timestamp, "actors": participants,
                          "left_side_rays": [ray], "commands": step["commands"]}
                history.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
                ego = participants["ego"]
                ego_transform = scene.actors["ego"].get_transform()
                ego_location = ego_transform.location
                trace.write(json.dumps({"video_frame": index, "frame": world_frame,
                                        "carla_frame": world_frame,
                                        "native_frame": world_frame, "time_s": timestamp,
                                        "position": {"x": ego_location.x,
                                                     "y": ego_location.y,
                                                     "z": ego_location.z},
                                        "heading_deg": ego_transform.rotation.yaw,
                                        "position_m": [ego["station_m"], ego["lateral_m"]],
                                        "speed_mps": ego["speed_mps"]}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
                graph.capture(world_frame, timestamp)
                original_count += 1
        cameras = {}
        for name, process in encoders.items():
            process.stdin.close()
            stderr = process.stderr.read()
            code = process.wait()
            process.stderr.close()
            cameras[name] = {"path": f"{name}.mkv", "sha256": _hash(output / f"{name}.mkv"),
                             "exit_code": code}
            if code != 0:
                raise ValueError("original camera encoder failed: " + stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-500:])
        encoders.clear()
    except BaseException as exc:
        _write(output / "native-run-status.json", {"case_id": case_id,
                "errors": [type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)],
                "frames_captured": original_count,
                "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if graph is not None:
                graph.close()
            for process in encoders.values():
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.kill()
                process.wait()
                if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                    process.stdin.close()
                if process.stderr and not process.stderr.closed:
                    process.stderr.close()
        finally:
            release = scene.close()
            _write(output / "owner-release.json", release)
    result = {"measured_values": {"original_frame_count": original_count},
              "target_checks": [{"target": "full_original_episode", "requested": packet["duration_s"]*20,
                                 "measured": original_count, "method": "continuous original CARLA frames",
                                 "tolerance": 0, "matched": original_count == packet["duration_s"]*20,
                                 "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                                 "cause_evidence": "bridge-history.jsonl; visual and physical review pending"}],
              "setup_confirmed": True, "behavior_attempted": True,
              "maneuver_completed": False, "termination_reason": "planned_duration",
              "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [f"{name}.mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": packet["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": {"bridge_history": "bridge-history.jsonl",
                                     "road_context": "road-context.json"},
              "realized_observables": {"physical_review": "pending"}}
    write_result(output, result)
    _write(output / "native-result.json", result)
    seal = seal_capture(output, frames=original_count, restoration=release["restoration"],
                        errors=[], encoder_exit_codes={name: c["exit_code"] for name, c in cameras.items()},
                        context={"road": packet["road"], "case_id": case_id})
    return {"case_id": case_id, "original_frames": original_count,
            "capture_seal": seal["source_digest"], "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}

"""Descriptive, source-bound bridge-approach measurements; no legal verdict."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

FEET_100_M = 30.48


def _number(value, name):
    if type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError(f"missing finite {name}")
    return float(value)


def measure(packet):
    road = packet["road"]
    if road.get("structure_type") != "bridge":
        raise ValueError("reviewed bridge identity required")
    entrance = _number(road.get("bridge_entrance_station_m"), "bridge entrance station")
    if road.get("one_way_highway") not in (True, False):
        raise ValueError("reviewed one-way highway status required")
    if not road.get("centerline_source_sha256") or not road.get("bridge_source_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed centerline and bridge sources required")
    frames = packet["frames"]
    if not frames:
        raise ValueError("original body and ray history required")
    output = []
    prior = None
    for index, row in enumerate(frames):
        if row.get("original_frame") != index:
            raise ValueError("original frame discontinuity")
        time_s = _number(row.get("time_s"), "original time")
        if prior is not None and time_s <= prior:
            raise ValueError("original time not increasing")
        prior = time_s
        ego = row.get("actors", {}).get("ego", {})
        front = _number(ego.get("front_station_m"), "ego front station")
        rear = _number(ego.get("rear_station_m"), "ego rear station")
        center = _number(ego.get("station_m"), "ego center station")
        if not rear <= center <= front:
            raise ValueError("ego body station ordering invalid")
        left_edge = _number(ego.get("centerline_signed_body_edge_m"), "ego left body edge")
        rays = row.get("left_side_rays")
        if not isinstance(rays, list) or not rays:
            raise ValueError("original view rays required")
        ray_values = []
        for ray in rays:
            length = _number(ray.get("clear_distance_m"), "ray distance")
            if length < 0 or ray.get("censored") not in (True, False):
                raise ValueError("invalid original ray bracket")
            ray_values.append({"clear_distance_m": length, "censored": ray["censored"],
                               "hit_kind": ray.get("hit_kind")})
        output.append({"original_frame": index, "time_s": time_s,
                       "bridge_distance_front_m": entrance-front,
                       "bridge_distance_center_m": entrance-center,
                       "bridge_distance_rear_m": entrance-rear,
                       "within_100ft_front_reference": -1e-9 <= entrance-front <= FEET_100_M+1e-9,
                       "left_body_edge_m": left_edge,
                       "left_of_center_body": left_edge > 0,
                       "ray_brackets": ray_values})
    return {"law_id": "NRS-484B-213-2c", "statutory_distance_m": FEET_100_M,
            "distance_reference_unresolved": "front, center and rear retained for review",
            "one_way_highway": road["one_way_highway"],
            "bridge_entrance_station_m": entrance,
            "per_frame": output, "view_obstructed_judgment": "unresolved",
            "legal_result": "unresolved"}

"""Focused bridge boundary, source and case validation tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from bridge_measure import measure
from native_scene import ASSIGNMENT, validate
from source_bind import bind


def frame(front, left=0.5, index=0):
    return {"original_frame": index, "time_s": (index+1)*0.05,
            "actors": {"ego": {"front_station_m": front, "rear_station_m": front-4,
                               "station_m": front-2, "centerline_signed_body_edge_m": left}},
            "left_side_rays": [{"clear_distance_m": 8, "censored": False,
                                "hit_kind": "opaque_obstacle"}]}


class BridgeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def road(self, one_way=False):
        return {"structure_type": "bridge", "bridge_entrance_station_m": 100,
                "one_way_highway": one_way, "centerline_source_sha256": "c",
                "bridge_source_sha256": "b", "public_highway": True,
                "lanes": [{"lane_id": "forward", "direction": 1}] +
                         ([] if one_way else [{"lane_id": "reverse", "direction": -1}]),
                "forward_unit_xy": [1, 0], "centerline_origin_xy": [0, 0]}

    def test_exact_100_foot_boundary_and_body_references(self):
        entrance = 100
        distances = [30.7848, 30.48, 30.1752]
        rows = [frame(entrance-gap, index=i) for i, gap in enumerate(distances)]
        result = measure({"road": self.road(), "frames": rows})
        got = result["per_frame"]
        self.assertEqual([row["within_100ft_front_reference"] for row in got],
                         [False, True, True])
        self.assertEqual([round(row["bridge_distance_front_m"], 4) for row in got], distances)
        self.assertTrue(all(row["bridge_distance_rear_m"] > row["bridge_distance_front_m"] for row in got))
        self.assertEqual(result["legal_result"], "unresolved")

    def test_missing_observation_rejected(self):
        row = frame(70)
        del row["left_side_rays"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "original view rays"):
            measure({"road": self.road(), "frames": [row]})

    def test_one_way_case_requires_one_way_source(self):
        case = ASSIGNMENT + "__one_way_exception"
        packet = {"case_id": case, "law_id": "NRS-484B-213-2c", "cell_id": "C31940",
                  "actor": "motor_vehicle_driver", "reviewed": True, "reviewer": "test",
                  "review_source_sha256": "review", "map_opendrive_sha256": "map",
                  "fps": 20, "duration_s": 45, "road": self.road(False)}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "case highway direction mismatch"):
            validate(packet, case)

    def test_source_binding_rejects_changed_bridge(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            roles = ["map", "highway", "centerline", "lane_forward", "lane_reverse",
                     "ego_vehicle", "bridge", "bridge_entrance", "view_geometry", "camera_plan"]
            entries = []
            for role in roles:
                file = root / role
                file.write_text(role)
                entries.append({"role": role, "path": role,
                                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(role.encode()).hexdigest()})
            packet = {"sources": entries,
                      "map_opendrive_sha256": next(e["sha256"] for e in entries if e["role"] == "map"),
                      "road": {"one_way_highway": False,
                               "centerline_source_sha256": next(e["sha256"] for e in entries if e["role"] == "centerline"),
                               "bridge_source_sha256": next(e["sha256"] for e in entries if e["role"] == "bridge")}}
            self.assertIn("bridge", bind(packet, root))
            (root / "bridge").write_text("changed")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "source bytes changed"):
                bind(packet, root)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
